result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with a functional layout. One minor styling inconsistency was found with the favorite/heart icon treatment across restaurant cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain outlined heart with no background, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent heart icon treatment (same background container and stroke style) across all restaurant cards for visual uniformity.
